source: The product owner's own words on 2026-11-08, recorded in .garura/project/issues/1021/context/capabilities.md, the note under the Spec → Design list. Seeding memory: "seeding memory is part of the play when we start building.. right now we are simply updating the model", then "seeding memory - drop it. also these are not lenses anymore." Lock the design: "we are not locking design, we can run this anytime. drop this and i think ouf bi2 is complete".

changes.old: **Outcome:** The project's positions are set for the whole project: technology and architecture, surfaces, deployment and environments. The memory each lens needs is seeded, and a design is locked before agents take over.

changes.old: **Why:** Without shared positions, each builder invents its own answer. Without the lock, agents drift.
changes.new: **Why:** Without shared positions, each builder invents its own answer.

changes.old: - Each lens has its memory.
